features: Supports one 4K (8 MP) camera channel in H.265 compression
Max. resolution for all cameras concurrently: Full HD 1080p at 30 fps in H.265 compression
PoE camera ports: 10/100 Mbps, max. 30 W per port
Network protocols: IPv4, IPv6, UDP, TCP, ICMP, SSL, TLS, ONVIF v2.2, DHCP, NTP, DNS, DDNS, SMTP, FTP, SNMP v2, HTTP, UPnP, RTSP, RTP, RTCP
Live view: simultaneous 3x3, 1+7, 1+5, 2x2 views or auto switch single view
Camera configuration through NVR: OSD, brightness, contrast, saturation, PTZ, motion detection, video tamper, video loss
Free TRENDnet IP View iOS / Android app
notes: Datasheet gives 10 W max. for the main board and 180 W max. fully loaded with HDD and PoE.
